description: Kerala state demographic indicators from 1950 onwards: life expectancy at birth (LE), infant mortality rate (IMR), child mortality (4q1), implied under-5 mortality (U5MR), total fertility rate (TFR), and crude birth rate (CBR). Compiled from peer-reviewed demographic literature; each block names its primary source. Where two sources give slightly different values for the same period (e.g. female LE 1951-60), both are kept so the discrepancy is visible.

note_units.imr: deaths under age 1 per 1000 live births
note_units.child_mortality_4q1: probability of death between exact ages 1 and 5, per 1000 children surviving to age 1
note_units.u5mr_implied: 1 - (1 - imr/1000)*(1 - 4q1/1000), expressed per 1000 live births; computed here, not lifted from source
note_units.tfr: total fertility rate, children per woman
note_units.cbr: crude birth rate, births per 1000 population

source_a.citation: M. V. George (2011), 'The Fertility Decline in India's Kerala State: A Unique Example of Below Replacement Fertility in a High Fertility Country', Canadian Studies in Population, 37(3-4): 563-600, Table 2.
source_a.underlying_sources_for_kerala_LE: Bhat & Rajan (1990) Table 3 for 1951-61 and 1961-71; Sample Registration System (SRS), Government of India, for later periods.

source_b.citation: Mari Bhat / Sample Registration System abridged life tables, as compiled in: 'Changes in mortality and human longevity in Kerala: are they leading to the advanced stage?' Asian Population Studies (Subaiya & Bansod 2013 / cited PMC article).

source_c_hpa.citation: Dreze & Sen (1989), 'Hunger and Public Action', Oxford: Clarendon. Reports Kerala LE 1976-80 as 66 years (68 female, 64 male) citing SRS Based Abridged Life-Tables 1976-80 (Occasional Paper No. 1, 1985), Registrar General of India.

source_a_csp_table2.citation: M. V. George (2011), Canadian Studies in Population 37(3-4), Table 2.
source_a_csp_table2.underlying_sources_for_kerala_IMR: Zachariah (1984) for 1951-60 and 1931-40; SRS Government of India for later years.

source_b_world_bank_kerala_3districts.citation: World Bank / Bhat (1986?), 'Trends and determinants of infant and child mortality in Kerala', Table 1. 3-district Kerala Fertility Survey + SRS comparison.

u5mr_implied_from_imr_and_4q1.method: U5MR = 1000 * [1 - (1 - imr/1000) * (1 - 4q1/1000)], using Kerala Fertility Survey 3-district series. This is an indicative state-level series; the source paper does not print U5MR directly.
u5mr_implied_from_imr_and_4q1.source: Computed here from World Bank Kerala 3-districts Fertility Survey table (see infant_mortality.source_b).

source.citation: M. V. George (2011), Canadian Studies in Population 37(3-4), Table 3: 'Crude Birth Rate and Total Fertility Rates for Kerala and India: 1931-2006'.
source.underlying_sources_for_kerala_TFR: Bhat & Rajan (1990) Table 9 for 1951-61 and 1961-71; SRS Government of India for 1971-1990; NFHS-1, NFHS-2, NFHS-3 for 1992-93 to 2005-06.

source.citation: M. V. George (2011), Canadian Studies in Population 37(3-4), Table 3.
source.underlying_sources_for_kerala_CBR: Zachariah (1984) Table 3.3 for 1931-40 to 1981; SRS estimates for 1981-85 and 1986-1990.

key_references.citation: Mari Bhat, P. N. & Irudaya Rajan, S. (1990). 'Demographic Transition in Kerala Revisited.' Economic and Political Weekly, 25(35-36): 1957-1980.
key_references.note: The canonical study of Kerala's pre-SRS demography. Source of Kerala LE 1951-61 and 1961-71 and TFR 1951-71 used by later compilations.

key_references.citation: Zachariah, K. C. (1984). 'The Anomaly of the Fertility Decline in India's Kerala State.' World Bank Staff Working Paper No. 700. Washington, DC.
key_references.note: Source of Kerala IMR and CBR 1931-40 to 1981 used by later compilations.

key_references.citation: George, M. V. (2011). 'The Fertility Decline in India's Kerala State: A Unique Example of Below Replacement Fertility in a High Fertility Country.' Canadian Studies in Population, 37(3-4): 563-600.
key_references.note: Compiles Kerala IMR, LE, TFR, CBR 1931-2006 from Bhat & Rajan, Zachariah, SRS, NFHS. Primary source for the long-run series above.

key_references.citation: Subaiya, L. & Bansod, D. W. (2013). 'Changes in mortality and human longevity in Kerala: are they leading to the advanced stage?' (PMC article).
key_references.note: Alternative compilation of Kerala LE by decade 1911-20 to 2001-08, using same Bhat/SRS underlying sources.

key_references.citation: World Bank (n.d., ~1986). 'Trends and Determinants of Infant and Child Mortality in Kerala.' Population, Health and Nutrition Department.
key_references.note: 3-district Kerala Fertility Survey + SRS. Source of pre-1971 IMR and child mortality (4q1) used here.

key_references.citation: Dreze, J. & Sen, A. (1989). Hunger and Public Action. Oxford: Clarendon Press, Chapter 11.
key_references.note: Reports Kerala LE 1976-80 as 66 (68 F / 64 M). Underlying source: SRS Based Abridged Life-Tables 1976-80, Registrar General of India. Does not contain Kerala TFR or U5MR time series.
